title: Table performance block — four phases
throughline: Warm reunion becomes shadow through merciful reset, then missing life — not horror announcement.

policy.shadow_is: rewind / edit / control until the encounter cannot surprise her
policy.note: Do not announce the shadow with scare cues. Let identical frames and absent spontaneity do the work.

animation_priorities.label: eyes and eyelines
animation_priorities.craft: Track who looks at whom; father's glance to window vs locked look at Oino after control.

animation_priorities.label: breathing
animation_priorities.craft: Alive irregular breath in Phases 1–2; Phase 4 breath locks to loop length.

animation_priorities.label: fingers and hand contact
animation_priorities.craft: Cup rim, table edge, playback keys; Oino's hand on control as the moral hinge.

animation_priorities.label: weight shifts
animation_priorities.craft: Chair settles, lean toward laugh, rise to leave; Phase 4 weight no longer drifts.

animation_priorities.label: Oino trying to conceal the reset
animation_priorities.craft: Body shields the control; eyes stay soft; mercy mask — not villain staging.

animation_priorities.label: the father's independent attention
animation_priorities.craft: Window, note preference, pause — life beyond her desire until she removes it.

animation_priorities.label: the instant Oino recognizes that her own hand is creating the loss
animation_priorities.craft: Eyeline from father's identical laugh down to her fingers still on the control; no sting.

phases.name: ARRIVAL

beats.staging: Hesitant weight; eyeline finds father mid-melody before she sits; warm light already on the table.
Hands already in the phrase; she arrives late to a life that was going on without her.
Familiar musical mistake — pleasure of recognition, not failure. Links TABLE_FATHER_MUSICAL_MISTAKE.

must_preserve: Father is already living before she enters
must_not: Lock father's attention only on Oino

phases.name: PLEASURE
phases.emotional_register: warm, pleasurable, funny, safe — why she stays

beats.staging: Small laugh; chest and shoulders live; timing must feel unplanned.
She takes her chair; body softens into safety; eyeline enjoys him.

beats.action: has a preference, distraction, or small disagreement
beats.staging: Disagreement about a note — tender and specific; two hearings, still safe.

beats.action: she enjoys his ordinary company; his attention can leave her
beats.staging: Glance toward the window; habit; ordinary pause — he is tender and specific, not a wish fulfilment puppet.

must_preserve: Father has life beyond Oino's desire
must_not: Foreshadow with red light or horror cue
Make father a monster under a digital face

phases.name: THE FIRST RESET
phases.emotional_register: merciful control; second pass a fraction too precise

beats.staging: Rise toward window or doorway; his life continues past her need. Links TABLE_FATHER_EXIT_BEGIN.
Hand finds PROP_PlaybackControl; she tries to conceal the reset — soft face, shielding body. Camera: CAM_TABLE_OINO_CONTROL.

beats.action: resets the scene; it feels merciful
beats.staging: No alarm. No red warning. The gesture reads as keeping love a moment longer — still almost kindness.

beats.action: second version plays a fraction too precise
beats.staging: Same warmth on the surface; timings slightly quantized; laugh arrives early-or-late by a hair that the ear notices as wrong-life.

must_preserve: Shadow enters through behaviour, not scare design

phases.name: THE LOSS OF SPONTANEITY
phases.emotional_register: dread from repetition and missing life

beats.staging: Ordinary pause deleted; silence no longer comfortable — it is absent.
Note disagreement gone; preference flattened; he agrees on cue.
No window glance; eyeline locked; independent attention dead.
He never begins to leave; loop seals the table.

beats.action: laughter occurs on exactly the same frame
beats.staging: Identical laugh frame each loop — dread without scare sting. Compare to living laugh at f120.

beats.action: his attention no longer moves independently
beats.staging: Eyes track Oino only; window unused; life-beyond-desire erased.

beats.action: recognizes that her own hand is creating the loss
beats.staging: Eyeline drops to her hand on the control; no monster face — she sees authorship of the missing life.

must_preserve: Dread from repetition and missing life
Recognition lands on Oino's hand, not a villain reveal
must_not: Monster reveal to announce the shadow

version_notes.pass_a_living: Phases 1–2 only as full life reference; keep mistakes, laughs, disagreements, glances, pauses, departure.
version_notes.pass_c_loss: Phase 4 — strip spontaneity; lock laugh to exact frame; freeze independent attention.
